gizmo.title: Ƙarfafawa ta tunanin kai
gizmo.description: Ka nemi ɗalibi ya yi tunani a kan maki ko yanayin zuciya, sannan ka ba da ƙarfafawa ta gyara kai bisa amsar.

configure.title: Nau'in shigarwa
configure.description: Yadda ɗalibi yake bayyana yadda yake yi. Duka biyun suna amfani da ma'auni na 0 zuwa 4 (maki: F=0, D=1, C=2, B=3, A=4; yanayin zuciya: ƙasa ƙwarai=0 zuwa mai kyau ƙwarai=4).

configure.title: Tambaya
configure.description: Tambaya ga ɗalibi. Bar shi babu komai don amfani da tsohon zaɓi na nau'in shigarwa.

configure.title: Ƙarfafawa
configure.description: Ra'ayin da ake nunawa ga jerin amsoshi. Ana amfani da jerin farko da ya dace.
